title: 第7章 黑鳞马青元仙城第8章 聚宝楼
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
白驹过隙，三日转眼而过。
晨光熹微，刚下过雨的清晨还带有丝丝寒意，顾安紧了紧青袍，锁上院门，心中感叹：“这一去便是三年，回来时又不知是何等光景。”
云履踏碎晨光，溅起青石板路上的点点泥星，向青云峰疾驰而去。
直至灵兽苑，顾安方才停下身形，看着灵兽苑的青石大门，顾安大步走进谷中。
一位同样穿青袍的青年迎面而来，笑着问道：“这位师弟，可是来挑选灵兽？”
顾安略一拱手，“师兄，师弟接了离宗任务，此次来是为了买一匹快马，不知师兄可有推荐。”
“出门在外是要买匹快马，在外行走保持自身状态很重要，用灵马来赶路，既节省法力，又不耽搁行程。”
“师弟倒是有经验。”
青袍师兄有些惊讶，一般来说这得是老手才知道的经验，新弟子不吃过几回亏是很难体会的。
看这位师弟面容如此年轻，总不能是经常执行任务的吧，那就应该是家中长辈的指点。
想到这，他的脸上泛起笑容，态度又好了些。
“我来为师弟介绍一下。”
“本门灵兽苑有一阶下品灵马，追云马，此马行进时蹄间生雾，耐力极好，可日行千里。“
“还有一阶下品嘶风马，青鬓嘶风，爆发速度极快，可日行八百里。”
“一阶中品火云驹，可……”
青袍师兄滔滔不绝的介绍起来，看起来很积极。
事实上，也确实很积极，灵兽苑的修士卖出去灵兽，是有灵石奖励的，这也是他积极的原因。
“额。”顾安有些尴尬的打断了师兄的话，“师兄，我想买匹凡马或半灵马就行，师弟实在是囊中羞涩。”
青袍师兄有点迷糊，这位师弟出任务长辈没给灵石吗？还是说猜错了？不过他也不坚持，反而介绍起了半灵马。
“师弟，半灵马我比较推荐黑鳞马，此马速度在半灵马中是数一数二的，耐力也不错，我宗已能稳定繁殖，因此价格也不贵，只需两块灵石，可谓价宜物善。”

“不知师兄可能带我看看！”顾安问道。
“应有之意！随我来。”青袍师兄引着顾安往谷里百十步，在第一间兽舍门口停下。
不用再介绍，顾安便知道这就是黑鳞马。只见黑鳞马通体黑色鳞甲，鬃毛随风飘扬，四肢虬结，鳞片铿锵，威武非凡！
看着就两股隐隐作痛，果然马如其名！
“咳，不知师兄可能赠副马鞍？”顾安涎着脸问道。
好在师兄爽朗大方，答应了一副马鞍，顾安便选了头高大健壮，看着顺眼的，套上马鞍，付过灵石，跨上黑鳞马，绝尘而去。
这黑鳞马日行五百里，三日半便可到，顾安打算先去青元仙城，购置一番。
青元仙城由青元宗一手建造，是青元宗收割散修资源的利器，其位置离青元宗不远，顾安半个时辰便已赶到。
此时雾已散，青石铺就的城墙里渗出晨露。顾安听得头顶传来破空声——一修士御着飞剑掠过城门，周围的人都投去羡慕的目光。
将黑鳞马放在门口兽舍内，缓步进城，映入眼帘的是散修支起的地摊，一块块黑布上摆着三五物件，不时有灵光闪烁，看的人心痒痒的。
content_en:
The white horse passed by, and three days passed by in the blink of an eye.
The morning light was dim, and there was still a hint of chill in the morning that had just rained. Gu An tightened his green robe, locked the courtyard door, and sighed in his heart: "I have been away for three years, and I don't know what the situation will be like when I come back."
The clouds trampled the morning light, splashing up the little bits of mud stars on the bluestone road, and rushed towards Qingyun Peak.
When he reached the Spiritual Beast Garden, Gu An stopped and looked at the bluestone gate of the Spiritual Beast Garden before he strode into the valley.
A young man also wearing a green robe came towards me and asked with a smile: "Is this junior brother here to choose a spiritual beast?"
Gu An slightly raised his hand and said, "Senior Brother, Junior Brother has taken over the mission of leaving the sect. This time I am here to buy a fast horse. I wonder if Senior Brother has any recommendations."
"When you go out, you need to buy a fast horse. It is very important to maintain your condition while walking. Using a spirited horse to drive on the road not only saves mana, but also does not delay the journey."
"Junior brother is quite experienced."
Senior Brother Qingpao was a little surprised. Generally speaking, this is an experience that only veterans know. It is difficult for new disciples to understand it without suffering a few losses.
Seeing that this junior fellow apprentice has such a young face, he must not be someone who often performs tasks. It should be the guidance of the elders in the family.
Thinking of this, a smile appeared on his face and his attitude became better.
"Let me introduce you to my junior brother."
"There is a low-grade spirit horse in our spiritual beast garden, the Chasing Cloud Horse. This horse has mist between its hooves when it travels. It has excellent endurance and can travel thousands of miles in a day."
"There is also a first-level low-grade neighing horse with green temples and a neighing wind. It can burst out very fast and can travel eight hundred miles a day."
"First-order middle-grade Fire Cloud Horse, but..."
Senior Brother Qingpao introduced it eloquently and seemed very positive.
In fact, he is indeed very active. The monks in the Spirit Beast Garden are rewarded with spirit stones when they sell spirit beasts. This is also the reason why he is active.
"Um." Gu An interrupted his senior brother with some embarrassment, "Senior brother, I just want to buy a mortal horse or a semi-spiritual horse. Junior brother is really short of money."
Senior Brother Qingpao is a little confused. Didn't the elder give this junior a spiritual stone when he went on a mission? Or did you guess wrong? However, he did not insist and instead introduced the semi-spiritual horse.
"Junior brother, for the semi-spiritual horse, I prefer the black-scaled horse. The speed of this horse is one of the best among the semi-spiritual horses, and the endurance is also good. Our sect has been able to breed stably, so the price is not expensive. It only requires two spiritual stones. It can be said that the price is good and the price is good."
"I wonder if senior brother can take me to see it!" Gu An asked.
"As it should be! Follow me." Senior Brother Qingpao led Gu An a hundred steps into the valley and stopped at the door of the first animal house.
Without further introduction, Gu An knew that this was the black scale horse. I saw the black-scaled horse with black scales all over its body, its mane fluttering in the wind, its limbs knotted, its scales clanking, and it was extremely powerful!
Just looking at it, I felt a dull pain in my two legs, and it really lived up to its name!
"Ahem, I wonder if senior brother can give me a saddle as a gift?" Gu An asked with saliva on his face.
Fortunately, the senior brother was hearty and generous, and agreed to a saddle. Gu An chose the one with a tall, strong head, which looked pleasing to the eye, put on the saddle, paid the spirit stone, climbed on the black-scaled horse, and rode away.
This black-scaled horse travels five hundred miles a day and can arrive in three and a half days. Gu An plans to go to Qingyuan Immortal City first to make some purchases.
Qingyuan Immortal City was built by the Qingyuan Sect. It was a powerful tool for the Qingyuan Sect to harvest the resources of casual cultivators. Its location was not far from the Qingyuan Sect, and Gu An had arrived in half an hour.
By this time the fog had dissipated, and morning dew seeped out of the city walls paved with bluestone. Gu An heard the sound of breaking through the air above his head - a monk flew past the city gate with a flying sword, and everyone around him cast envious glances.
Putting the black-scaled horse in the animal shed at the door, he walked slowly into the city. What he saw was a stall set up by casual cultivators. There were three or five objects placed on pieces of black cloth. From time to time, there were flashes of spiritual light, which made people feel itchy.
